title: Hearty Hot Venezuelan Chicken Tagine
description: A fresh and light Venezuelan dish featuring ketchup and cooked in a tagine, with ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients, this recipe is perfect for a warm dinner
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly
Add the chicken to the pot and cook until it is browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes
Add the ketchup, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the pot and stir to combine
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened, about 20-25 minutes
Serve the chicken and sauce hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro or scallions, if desired
